sourceNote: Birth year and birthplace uncertain (Wikipedia gives 1175, other sources c. 1180). Parents (Berthold IV of Merania and Agnes of Rochlitz) are not yet in the roster.
notes: Third wife of Philippe II Augustus. The 1196 marriage was contracted while Ingeborg lived and was declared invalid in 1201; her children were legitimised in November 1201. She was treated as queen but never canonically queen consort. Modelled as a former marriage (broken line), following the Eleanor x Louis VII pattern.

deathCause.detail: Agnes died in July 1201 at the castle of Poissy, possibly in childbirth, and was buried in the Convent of Saint-Corentin near Mantes.
deathCause.detailCn: 1201 年 7 月，阿涅丝在普瓦西城堡去世（可能死于分娩），葬于芒特附近的圣科朗坦修道院。

events.label: Born in Merania
events.note: Birth year uncertain (c. 1175–1180); birthplace not recorded. Daughter of Berthold IV, Duke of Merania, of the House of Andechs.

events.label: Marriage to Philippe II
events.note: Married June 1196 while Philippe's second wife Ingeborg was still living; under canon law the marriage was never valid.

events.label: Birth of Philippe Hurepel
events.labelCn: 儿子菲利普·于雷佩尔出生

events.label: Died at Poissy
events.note: Died in July 1201 (some sources give 19/20 July), possibly in childbirth; her marriage had been declared invalid earlier that year.

events.label: Children legitimised by Pope Innocent III
events.labelCn: 子女获教皇英诺森三世承认为婚生
events.note: Marie and Philippe Hurepel were legitimised by papal dispensation in November 1201, after Agnes's death.
